product_overview: LingoMaster is an AI-assisted, chapter-based English learning web app that lets users progress through levels with interactive questions, get immediate feedback, and ask an AI tutor for help. Administrators can manage levels and questions via an admin panel.
core_goals: Browse available learning levels and see which are locked or unlocked
Start a level and answer interactive question types (multiple choice, fill-in-the-blank)
Receive immediate correct/incorrect feedback and track progress locally
Ask the AI Tutor for explanations, translations, or grammar help while learning
Allow administrators to create, edit, and remove levels and questions

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow existing users to authenticate and access their learning progress and unlocked levels.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open login modal -> Fill username -> Fill password -> Submit login form -> See account-level interface with levels and progress

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Enable new users to create an account with username, email, and password and land in a logged-in state.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open registration form -> Fill username -> Fill email -> Fill password -> Submit registration form -> See account created and logged in state
Navigate to / -> Open registration form -> Fill username -> Fill invalid email -> Fill password -> Submit registration form -> See validation error about email format

features.name: Browse and Start Levels
features.description: View the list of levels, identify locked vs unlocked sections, and start an unlocked level to begin answering questions.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See list of levels with locked and unlocked status -> Select an unlocked level to start -> Begin level and view the first question

features.name: Answer Questions and Track Progress
features.description: Complete questions within a level, receive immediate feedback, and persist progress so subsequent sessions reflect completed levels.
user_flows: Start a level -> Read a question -> Submit an answer -> See correct or incorrect feedback -> Move to next question -> Complete level and see completion confirmation and next level unlocked
Start a level -> Read a question -> Submit empty answer -> See validation message prompting for an answer

features.name: AI Tutor
features.description: Ask the built-in AI Tutor for hints, translations, or grammar explanations related to exercises or general English queries.
user_flows: Use the app while studying -> Open the AI Tutor widget -> Type a question about the current exercise or grammar -> Submit the question -> See an explanatory response or hint from the AI Tutor

features.name: Admin: Manage Levels and Questions
features.description: Allow administrators to create, edit, and delete levels and questions to curate learning content.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate as admin -> View list of levels -> Create a new level by providing title and metadata -> Submit new level form -> See the new level in the admin list
Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate as admin -> View a level's details -> Add a question by specifying question type and content -> Submit question form -> See the new question listed for the level
Navigate to /admin -> Authenticate as admin -> View a level's question list -> Delete a question -> Confirm deletion -> See the question removed from the list
